concerns.text: Task T017 (Context Simulator Sampling) is marked as unchecked [ ] in the tasks list, despite being a critical implementation step for FR-002 and US1. The spec requires the system to 'randomly sample exactly one rationale' and handle edge cases (re-sampling/exclusion). Without this task being marked as actionable/complete, the downstream tasks (T020, T048) that depend on `data/context_splits.json` cannot be executed, leaving the core data pipeline broken.

Task T020 (Inference-Only Pass) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This task is required to implement FR-014 and FR-003 (computing the Teacher Distribution). The Analyze report correctly identifies that T020 depends on T017, but T020 itself is also missing a completion marker, blocking the entire training loop (US2).

Task T048 (Teacher Distribution Averaging) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This task is required to implement FR-003 (averaging logits to form the teacher distribution). It depends on T021 (which is checked) but T048 itself is not marked as a task to be implemented, creating a gap in the implementation of the core AntiSD signal.

Task T035.1 (Generate Reference Subset) is marked as unchecked [ ]. This task is required to implement FR-010 and FR-015 (creating the human-annotated subset for the Human Evaluation Proxy). Without this task, T035-SIM and T047 cannot function, leaving the quality validation (US3) incomplete.

Task T017 description includes a logic note: 'If identical rationales persist after N=10 attempts, exclude the prompt'. While the logic is described, the task is not marked as implemented (unchecked). Additionally, the task description is slightly ambiguous about whether the exclusion logic is part of T017 or T017.1, though T017.1 is marked checked. The unchecked status is the primary blocker.
